name: Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026
short_description: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is a full marathon, half marathon, and 10km race held in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia on 22 November 2026.
ai_summary: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is a road race scheduled for 22 November 2026 in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia. Organized by the Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, the event offers full marathon, half marathon, and 10km distances. Pricing is set at RM140 for the half marathon and RM170 for the full marathon, per elopuramarathon.com. Registration has not yet been announced.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 offers three distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, and a shorter 10km race. This gives participants of varying experience levels and fitness the option to choose a distance that suits them.
